turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for contacting Acme Brands! How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I need to see what my order's status is. I think that the wrong payment method might have been used.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Alright, the first thing I need is your full name and order ID please.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My name is Albert Sanders and my order ID is 5789676195.

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Account has been pulled up for Albert Sanders.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you and can you verify your account ID for me?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What is the shipping status of your order?

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Shipping status of order received has been noted.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What should your method of payment be for this order?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I wanted to use my debit card.

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Order has been updated with debit card.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Since the order hasn't been shipped, I've updated your order to use your debit card.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're welcome. Can I help you with anything else?
